judgement.reason: CommaFeed supports PostgreSQL, and the Dockerfile that copies CI-built artifacts needs a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is right.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /commafeed/data (commafeed-server/src/main/docker/Dockerfile.jvm)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that /commafeed/data holds only replaceable data, because the default build uses the embedded H2 database and no shown setting selects PostgreSQL for this image.
